change: Production shared validator with deferred error construction; full supported packed-program launches, not an isolated validator or prepared-artifact prototype.

build.toolchain_child: Identical real release baml-cli for both wrappers; wrapper --version and baml run --help include child execution. BAML_TOOLCHAIN points at cli-child, an exact copy of baseline baml-cli.

methodology.platform: Apple M2 Max, 64 GiB, 12 logical CPUs, native aarch64, macOS 15.6.1 (24G90), Rust 1.98.0 (88d9e12ae 2026-08-18).
methodology.release: Normal cargo release: opt-level=3, fat LTO, codegen-units=1, stripped symbols, unwind panics. Compiler linked and available. No startup-experiment feature, unsupported artifact format, compiler removal or allocator replacement.
methodology.baseline: Preserved normal release CLI/host from c43da5cc7c0e6fe5d95b51806e4203995d1000de, verified against earlier recorded hashes. Runtime/compiler source and Cargo manifests/lockfile are unchanged between that revision and the production PR parent; intervening changes are docs/benchmarks only.
methodology.candidate: Cargo-built CLI/host at the recorded candidate revision, copied before testing. Each release CLI packs the identical BAML project sources with its corresponding host.
methodology.wall_ms: Native C helper starts CLOCK_MONOTONIC before posix_spawn, drains stdout, queries root-process counters and stops after wait4 reaps the root. Includes native loading, VM/artifact/engine initialization, target execution, real CLI child work where applicable, telemetry shutdown, destruction and exit. No phase subtraction or reconstruction.
methodology.cases: Empty Main, print ready, JSON/defaults/callbacks/floats/catch, 1000 extra functions, typed/default arguments, generated help, wrapper --version, wrapper run --help. Wrapper commands use the same real release baml-cli child (cli-child), with an explicit local toolchain path; no placeholder child.
methodology.telemetry: off sets BAML_TELEMETRY=off; local omits it and uses default local recording. Isolated HOME/BAML_HOME, auto_check=false, fixed real BAML_TOOLCHAIN, allow-direct CLI; no inherited credentials/cloud destination or production cloud traffic. Pack/smoke checks use telemetry off.
methodology.sampling: 100 rounds x 8 commands x 2 releases x 2 recording modes = 3200 timed fresh launches, plus 3 warmups for each of 32 variants (96 launches). Fixed seed 20261004, shuffled interleaving. 18 independent output/error correctness launches.
methodology.external_builds: Own release build finished before measurement. Other checkouts started/stopped compiling during the run; the harness waited before warmups and each timing round until no rustc/cargo/clippy workers appeared. All 100 round-start snapshots show no build workers. Work starting inside a round and other desktop activity are not controlled; pause messages and snapshots are retained.
methodology.caches: Executable/file caches warmed; fresh processes, not a cold-cache/boot test. No physical Linux/Windows/iOS/Wasm latency conclusion.
methodology.statistics: Median and nearest-rank p95 (95th sorted sample of 100), min and max. Individual medians are compared directly, not summed phase estimates. Tail latency remains noisy: empty/local p95 rises in this run and wrapper-version/off p95 rises; this is a modest median reduction, not a claim that every tail improves.
methodology.other_metrics: CPU is OS user+system accounting, including reaped-child usage as attributed by wait4. Root near-exit instruction/cycle/footprint/I/O counters are not a summed process-tree total. RSS is wait4 peak RSS. Counters are supporting data; full wall time is the outcome.
methodology.raw_encoding: columns gives metric order; each raw.samples row reconstructs one complete scalar sample. Lossless reconstruction and all 32 summaries verified against original output.
methodology.replay: Restore compare.py and the C helper/BAML wrapper sources from sources; adjust the two recorded absolute source paths to the replay checkout. Prepare the two ordinary release CLI/host directories at the recorded revisions and copy the baseline real CLI to OUTPUT/cli-child. Run the recorded measurement command with those output paths. Frozen harness docstring is clarified after measurement; executed code is unchanged.

body='''Valid compiled programs currently format validation context for every object, global and declaration during normal loading. Program validation now skips diagnostic construction on success; invalid programs repeat the same checks to explain the first failure.

```baml
function Main() -> void {}
```

Users keep the same source, invocation, normal artifact format and result. On this machine, **full packed-program launch to exit improves 2–4%** across the measured commands. The improvement is shared by all callers of the Program → VM validation boundary; there is no new user API or runtime flag.

## Full launch to exit

Default local recording; **median / p95**, 100 fresh processes per cell:

'''+table('local')+'''

Telemetry off, same complete process boundary:

'''+table('off')+'''

The wrapper runs the **real release baml-cli**, using an explicit local toolchain path. Both wrapper releases use the identical child binary, so this includes its execution while isolating the wrapper/runtime change. `run --help` measures forwarding and CLI help, not compiling/executing a user project. Empty/other program rows are actual standalone packed applications.

The typical end-to-end saving is about 0.5–1.2 ms. Tail latency remains noisy: empty/local and wrapper-version/off p95 increase in this run. This is a modest median improvement.

### Methodology

Apple M2 Max / native aarch64 / macOS 15.6.1 / Rust 1.98.0. Both releases use the normal opt-level 3/fat LTO/one codegen unit/stripped symbols/unwind profile, with the compiler linked. Before is the preserved release build from c43da5cc7c0e6fe5d95b51806e4203995d1000de, whose runtime/compiler sources and Cargo manifests are identical to this PR's parent; intervening changes are docs/benchmarks. After is Cargo-built at 5149a8c8c01227cb6d81f8f9922b432b803071b2. Each CLI packs the identical sources with its matching host. The seven matched payloads differ only in nested artifact build identity and its authenticated hash; remaining bytes are identical.

The native parent measures from before process creation through `wait4` reaping. It includes native loading, artifact/VM/engine construction, execution and real child work, recording shutdown, destruction and exit. No diagnostic phase timings are added together to estimate this result.

3,200 measured launches, 96 warmups and 18 independent output/error checks. Fixed-seed shuffled interleaving, warm executable/file caches, isolated HOME/BAML_HOME, disabled update checks, no inherited cloud destination/credentials. Own builds finish first; the harness also waits for external rustc/cargo/Clippy workers before every timing round. All 100 round-start snapshots are clear. Work starting inside a round and other desktop activity are uncontrolled. No cold-cache, cross-platform, cloud-delivery or experimental-artifact claim.

[Full launch data and replay sources]('''+link+''') retain every scalar sample, all 32 summaries, source/build commands, dependency/artifact hashes, output/error checks, exact BAML/C/Python sources and build-activity logs.

## Shared validation interface

```rust
pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), InvalidProgram> {
    self.validate_with::<CheckOnly>()
        .or_else(|()| self.validate_with::<ExplainError>())
}
```

The generic validator contains all checks once; Rust resolves the diagnostic interface statically. `CheckOnly::Error = ()` ignores deferred message closures. `ExplainError::Error = InvalidProgram` evaluates them only when a check fails. A valid program takes one walk; an invalid program repeats up to its first failure. Validation order and exact error messages are preserved.

Supporting diagnostic probes show empty-program validation allocation requests falling 11,578 → 31, with remaining allocations for bookkeeping. Isolated validator timings are retained for attribution; the full-launch tables above are the product result. [Diagnostic data and replay sources](https://github.com/BoundaryML/baml/blob/codex/baml-validation-fast-path/baml_language/scripts/runtime-startup/validation-fast-path-results-20261004.json).

## Validation

- `cargo test -p bex_vm_types --lib`: 106 passed.
- `cargo test -p baml_tests --test program_validation`: nine passed, covering compiled programs and malformed roots, declarations, cells, heads, switches, operands, virtual calls and init order.
- Standalone original/new validator comparison: 115 cases agree on success/failure and exact error text.
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Normal release CLI/host build and all 18 end-to-end output/error checks: passed.
- Repository pre-commit formatting/Clippy checks: passed for the runtime implementation; this follow-up records measurements only.

Stacked above the startup measurement PR #5137. This ships normal program validation; schema deferral and the execution-ready artifact remain saved experiments in that parent.
'''
(out/'pr-body.md').write_text(body)
